## Walkthrough Makefile and many collection-scripts were modified to improve shell safety and shellcheck compatibility: Makefile lint narrows targets to shebanged scripts; scripts switch to quoted sourcing, tighten variable/path quoting, improve array handling, and add targeted ShellCheck annotations/suppressions. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Makefile - lint target**
`Makefile`|Replaced broad `shellcheck ./**/*.sh` with a `find` pipeline that selects regular files under `SCRIPT_DIRS` containing a shebang and runs `$(SHELLCHECK) -x` on them.| |**Sourcing & ShellCheck annotations**
`collection-scripts/gather`, `collection-scripts/gather_audit_logs`, `collection-scripts/gather_kas_startup_termination_logs`, `collection-scripts/gather_metrics`, `collection-scripts/gather_monitoring`, `collection-scripts/gather_nmstate`, `collection-scripts/gather_olm`, `collection-scripts/gather_olm_v1`, `collection-scripts/gather_osus`, `collection-scripts/gather_ppc`, `collection-scripts/gather_service_logs`, `collection-scripts/gather_vsphere`, `collection-scripts/gather_windows_node_logs`, `collection-scripts/openshift-must-gather`|Changed `source $(dirname "$0")/...` to `source "$(dirname "$0")/..."`, added `# shellcheck source=...` annotations and localized `# shellcheck disable=...` comments around intentional patterns.| |**Quoting paths/args & redirections**
`collection-scripts/gather_apirequestcounts`, `collection-scripts/gather_core_dumps`, `collection-scripts/gather_haproxy_config`, `collection-scripts/gather_machineconfig_ondisk`, `collection-scripts/gather_machineconfigdaemon_termination_logs`, `collection-scripts/gather_metallb`, `collection-scripts/gather_network_logs`, `collection-scripts/gather_network_logs_basics`, `collection-scripts/gather_ppc_single_node`, `collection-scripts/gather_profiling_node`, `collection-scripts/gather_service_logs_util`, `collection-scripts/gather_etcd`|Wrapped directory/file/argument expansions in quotes, adjusted concatenation of destination paths, and fixed redirection spacing to prevent word-splitting/globbing issues.| |**Array, pod selection & PID/wait handling**
`collection-scripts/gather_frrk8s`, `collection-scripts/gather_etcd_more`, `collection-scripts/gather_osus`, `collection-scripts/gather_profiling_node`, `collection-scripts/gather_sriov`, `collection-scripts/gather_network_logs_basics`, `collection-scripts/gather_ppc`|Replaced implicit splitting with `read -ra` or quoted array assignments, iterated with `for x in "${arr[@]}"`, and made PID checks/waits use array-length tests and `wait "${PIDS[@]}"`.| |**Targeted ShellCheck suppressions for intentional unquoted expansion**
`collection-scripts/gather_etcd_more`, `collection-scripts/gather_ingress_node_firewall`, `collection-scripts/gather_insights`, `collection-scripts/gather_istio`, `collection-scripts/gather_metallb`, `collection-scripts/gather_sriov`, `collection-scripts/gather_vsphere`, `collection-scripts/gather_olm*`, `collection-scripts/gather_frrk8s`|Inserted `# shellcheck disable=SC2086` and other specific disables immediately before `oc adm inspect ${log_collection_args}` and similar lines where unquoted expansion is intentionally preserved.| |**Minor command/argument tweaks**
`collection-scripts/gather_aro`, `collection-scripts/gather_core_dumps` (other small files)|Small fixes: quote array element during assignment (`"${ARO_CR_NAME}"`), concatenate path components into single strings for `oc cp` destinations, and minor spacing/format changes with no logic change.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 12

Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | This pull request is not applicable to the Stable and Deterministic Test Names check because the repository uses BATS for testing, not Ginkgo. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | Custom check not applicable; PR modifies only shell scripts and Makefile, uses BATS testing framework, no Ginkgo test code present. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This check does not apply to this pull request. The custom check is designed to assess MicroShift compatibility for newly added Ginkgo e2e tests in Go. This PR is a bash shell script linting fix in the openshift/must-gather repository, which contains no Go test code and adds no Ginkgo tests. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only shell diagnostic scripts and Makefile for linting; contains no Ginkgo e2e tests or test code, making SNO compatibility check inapplicable. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This pull request modifies only shell data collection scripts and build/tooling configurations. It contains no Kubernetes deployment manifests, operator code, or controller code, making the topology-aware scheduling compatibility check not applicable. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR contains only shell script linting fixes with no Go code changes; OTE Binary Stdout Contract check applies only to process-level Go code. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR contains only shell script and Makefile changes for linting improvements. The custom check targets Ginkgo e2e tests, which do not exist in this shell script-based repository and are not introduced in this PR. |

collection-scripts/gather_sriov (1)
`75-75`: _⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_ **Hardcoded namespace remains; all other `oc exec` sites in this PR were switched to `${operator_ns}`.** This is the only `oc exec` call in the file that still pins to `openshift-sriov-network-operator` instead of the discovered `${operator_ns}`. On clusters where the SR-IOV operator is installed in a different namespace, `oc exec` here fails, `devices` ends up empty, and `gather_bf_info` falsely reports "No Mellanox devices detected by mstconfig". This was previously raised and appears to have been missed when the rest of the file was updated.
Proposed fix ```diff - devices=$(oc exec -n openshift-sriov-network-operator "${1}" -c sriov-network-config-daemon -- mstconfig q 2>/dev/null | grep "Device:" | awk 'BEGIN {FS="/";} { print $6 }') + devices=$(oc exec -n "${operator_ns}" "${1}" -c sriov-network-config-daemon -- mstconfig q 2>/dev/null | grep "Device:" | awk 'BEGIN {FS="/";} { print $6 }') ```
